confusions: Initial geography was slightly disorienting — took a wrong path early and encountered a wolf before finding alternate routes to shrine/tower
The relationship between loose stone (hidden entrance) and tally marks took a moment to connect, though it worked well once understood
suggestions: Consider adding minor compass/direction cues at junction points to reduce navigation friction
Score feedback for verse collection appears only at end — intermediate feedback would feel more rewarding
The wolf difficulty curve was well-balanced, but a brief combat tutorial or hint would help new players
The moral choice (seal vs open barrow) could be slightly more highlighted before the final decision
Excellent use of Scholar class advantage — the verse recall without rolls felt satisfying and rewarded class choice
